owner_algorithm: Single default_rng(20261010), rng.integers(0,2,size) per type in DATA insertion order; independent Bernoulli .5 owners; source=0,target=1; no split retry

source.feature_provenance: ACM: fixed supplied paper-word attributes, row-normalized independently per retained node. Shared feature-column semantics are fixed input; upstream construction of the supplied paper vocabulary is not newly inferred from source-only data.
source.positive_policy: Sum symmetrically normalized graph-local binary metapath adjacency; rank off-diagonal neighbors, at most 8; include self; all variants use the identical fixed positives.
source.projection_validation: Every sampled row verified by independent raw-relation path traversal, without released metapath/positive matrices.

target.feature_provenance: ACM: fixed supplied paper-word attributes, row-normalized independently per retained node. Shared feature-column semantics are fixed input; upstream construction of the supplied paper vocabulary is not newly inferred from source-only data.
target.positive_policy: Sum symmetrically normalized graph-local binary metapath adjacency; rank off-diagonal neighbors, at most 8; include self; all variants use the identical fixed positives.
target.projection_validation: Every sampled row verified by independent raw-relation path traversal, without released metapath/positive matrices.

limitation: Within one dataset and fixed attribute schema; all typed nodes and raw edges are disjoint. Source/target class distributions can differ. DBLP-L uses graph-local rebuilt 4231-column author attributes and is not numerically comparable to the original 334-column DBLP main-table protocol. The fixed supplied paper-word vocabulary is shared. This is not cross-dataset transfer or a graph foundation model test.
